key: The LLM is a talented cook in a dhaba
name: ch07_dhaba_cook_and_helpers
alt: A dhaba cook at his stove surrounded by an order slip, an order book, a boy running to market and a cashier with a calculator.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated view into a busy roadside dhaba kitchen at dusk, open to the highway on one side. At the centre a talented middle-aged cook (stocky, white vest, checked lungi, red towel on his shoulder, sweat on his brow, confident grin) stands at a big iron tawa with flames licking up. To his left, a steel clip on the wall holds a neat printed order slip reading "T4: 2 paneer, less spicy". Just below it, on a ledge, sits a thick, worn order book open to a page with tick marks next to table numbers. On the right side of the frame, two helpers: a skinny teenage boy in shorts and slippers sprinting out of the back door with a cloth bag, a thought bubble above the cook showing three red tomatoes and an arrow pointing at the boy; and at a small wooden counter near the entrance, a bespectacled cashier in a sweater punching numbers into a desktop calculator. In the background, truck drivers sit on charpais eating, steam rising from plates. A small inset bubble in the corner shows the same cook looking blank, scratching his head, with the order book missing from its ledge. Warm orange firelight, smoky and lively. Labels: "TEMPLATE" on the order slip, "MEMORY" on the order book, "TOOLS" above the boy and the cashier.

key: pipe fitting in a plumber
name: ch07_pipe_fittings_chain
alt: A plumber screws a filter, a meter and an extension pipe onto a tap in a chain, each piece with matching threads.
scene: A close, eye-level view of a plumber's workbench in a small hardware shop, with a brass tap mounted on a short wall pipe at the left edge of the frame. A plumber in his forties (khaki uniform shirt, rolled sleeves, pencil behind his ear, calm focused face) is mid-twist, screwing a cylindrical white water filter directly onto the tap's spout. Already lined up on the bench to the right, in a neat row, are the next fittings waiting their turn: a round water meter with a small dial, then a long chrome extension pipe ending in a shower rose. Every fitting shows identical shiny threads at both ends, and thin dotted arrows loop from the end of one fitting to the start of the next, showing they can be joined in any order. A clear trickle of water runs through the already joined tap and filter. Behind him, pegboard walls hold spanners, coils of PVC pipe and plastic bins of washers. A small inset bubble in the top right corner shows two fittings with mismatched threads, one fat and one thin, refusing to join, with a little red cross between them. Bright daytime light from the shop's open shutter, practical and tidy. Labels: "LLM" on the tap, "CHAIN" along the row of fittings.

key: A railway reservation form. The clerk
name: ch07_reservation_form_template
alt: At a railway reservation counter, a clerk accepts a filled printed form but stares blankly at a handwritten note.
scene: A split-panel illustration of the same railway reservation counter seen from the passenger's side, divided by a thin vertical line. Both halves show a steel grille window with a small round speaking hole, a computer monitor glowing inside, and a tired clerk in his fifties (grey safari suit, reading glasses on a cord, moustache). LEFT panel: a young woman in a salwar kameez with a sling bag slides a crisp printed pink reservation form through the slot; every box is filled in neat block letters, with visible boxes for train number, date and passenger rows. The clerk nods and types, and a printed ticket is already curling out of the printer beside him. RIGHT panel: a young man in a hoodie pushes a scrap of torn notebook paper through the slot with a scribbled line, "2 tickets Pune tomorrow". The clerk's screen is completely blank, he sits motionless, and the paper lies untouched; a small empty speech bubble above the window holds nothing at all, not even a word. A queue of travellers with suitcases waits behind both of them under a departures board. Fluorescent station light, slightly harried mood. Labels: "TEMPLATE" over the left panel, "NO TEMPLATE" over the right panel.

key: A wedding card printer in Sivakasi
name: ch07_wedding_card_assembly_line
alt: Three workers in a wedding card press pass a card along a bench, each adding one thing: names, design, final print.
scene: A side-on view of a long wooden workbench inside a small printing press, the kind found in a south Indian printing town, with stacks of glossy wedding cards in red, gold and maroon everywhere. Three workers sit in a row from left to right, and one card travels down the bench between them along a dotted arrow. LEFT: an older man with white stubble and thick glasses, in a half-sleeve shirt, carefully setting metal type letters into a small frame for the couple's names, a tray of type beside him. CENTRE: a young woman in a cotton saree with her hair in a plait, holding the name strip next to three sample card designs fanned out and picking the one with a golden elephant border, comparing them thoughtfully. RIGHT: a burly man in a vest operating a hand-cranked printing press, pulling out a finished card that shows both the names and the elephant border together. Each worker glances at what the previous one passed along. Behind them, finished cards hang on strings to dry. An inset bubble at the top left shows one exhausted worker juggling type, designs and the press alone, with smudged cards falling. Warm tungsten light, busy and cheerful. Labels: "STEP 1", "STEP 2" and "STEP 3" above the three workers.

key: A cricket commentator who, before every
name: ch07_commentator_rereads_log
alt: A cricket commentator buried under a growing paper log of every ball, reading from the first over before each new ball.
scene: A two-panel illustration inside a stadium commentary box with a big window overlooking a sunlit cricket ground. The same commentator appears in both panels: a man in his fifties, blazer and tie, headset with a microphone, reading glasses perched on his nose. LEFT panel: early in the match, the scoreboard outside reads "OVER 2"; he holds a single short sheet of paper, glances at it quickly and speaks cheerfully into the mic as the bowler runs in. RIGHT panel: late in the match, the scoreboard reads "OVER 45"; his desk is buried under a long scroll of ball-by-ball log paper that spills off the desk and piles onto the floor in loops. He is hunched over, running his finger down the very first line at the top, sweat on his forehead, while outside the bowler waits at the top of his run-up and the umpire checks his watch. A small inset bubble in the corner shows an even longer scroll cascading out of the door, too long to fit in the box at all. Bright afternoon light through the glass, the mood shifting from breezy to comically overwhelmed. Labels: "FULL HISTORY" on the paper scroll, "EVERY BALL" over the right panel.

key: A sharp kirana shop owner who chats
name: ch07_shopkeeper_reaches_calculator
alt: A chatty kirana shop owner reaches for a calculator for a big bill and a phone for the wholesaler's rates.
scene: An eye-level view across the front counter of a crowded neighbourhood kirana shop, shelves behind packed with rice sacks, biscuit packets and soap boxes. The owner, a cheerful man in his forties (round face, white kurta, sandalwood mark on his forehead), is chatting and laughing with a customer, an elderly lady with a cloth shopping bag. At the same time he is reaching his right hand to a chunky calculator on the counter, its display reading "3847 x 12", while his left hand holds a phone to his ear, with a small speech bubble from the phone showing a tiny truck and a price tag, as if the wholesaler is reading out today's rates. Above his head, a thought bubble shows a tangled scribble of numbers with a question mark, crossed out, to show he does not even try mental maths. On the right of the counter, a long handwritten bill sits on a spike. In the background a delivery boy loads crates onto a bicycle. A tiny inset in the bottom corner shows a robot-like figure looking only at a strip of printed paper handed to it, not at the calculator itself. Warm late-morning light, friendly and busy. Labels: "TOOL" on the calculator, "TOOL" on the phone, "LLM" above the owner.

key: Sending a new office boy to buy
name: ch07_office_boy_receipt
alt: A new office boy returns with a purchase and a total, while a second version of him brings a receipt and phones before paying.
scene: A split-panel illustration of an Indian office setting, divided by a thin vertical line, the same office boy in both halves: a lanky lad of about nineteen in an oversized pale-blue shirt, khaki trousers and sandals. LEFT panel: in a cluttered office cabin, he hands a cardboard box with a printer cartridge and a scrap of paper reading "Total 4200" to his boss, a woman manager in her thirties with a laptop, who looks at it with a raised eyebrow; above her a cloud shows two shop fronts with question marks, as if wondering whether he checked both or paid double at the first. RIGHT panel: the same boy standing outside a small electronics shop, phone to his ear, holding up the item to show it, with a long printed receipt hanging from his other hand; a tiny speech bubble from the phone says "OK, buy". Back in the office in the corner of this panel, the manager smiles, holding the receipt. The street behind the shop has signboards, a parked scooter and a chai cart. Clear daytime light; left half uneasy, right half reassured. Labels: "NO SOURCE" over the left panel, "RECEIPT" on the receipt, "CHECK" above the phone call.

key: Railway enquiry at a big station. Dense
name: ch08_enquiry_three_clerks
alt: At a station enquiry office, one clerk pulls ten timetable pages, a senior clerk ranks them, and a third answers the traveller.
scene: A wide, eye-level view across the long wooden counter of a big railway station's enquiry office, three clerks working side by side from left to right, with a traveller standing at the far right window. LEFT: a young clerk in a white shirt and tie, sleeves rolled, pulling a fan of ten loose timetable pages out of a towering cabinet of thick timetable books, moving fast. CENTRE: a senior clerk in his sixties (grey hair, half-moon glasses, cardigan) has those ten pages spread on the desk and is carefully reading them, sliding the best one to the top of the pile with one finger. RIGHT: a calm middle-aged woman clerk in a cotton saree leans toward the window, one hand pointing at a line on the top page, the other raised as she speaks to the traveller, a tired young man with a backpack and phone; her speech bubble reads "22:15, platform 4". A dotted arrow runs from the cabinet to the first clerk, to the second, to the third, to the traveller. Behind them, a big departures board glows amber and a ceiling fan turns. Busy late-evening station light, orderly and helpful. Labels: "RETRIEVE" above the left clerk, "RERANK" above the centre clerk, "RAG" above the right clerk.

key: wedding hall seating plan where guests
name: ch08_wedding_hall_seating
alt: A guest walks into a wedding hall where friends sit grouped at tables and heads for the nearest familiar table.
scene: A high-angle, almost bird's-eye view of a grand Indian wedding reception hall decorated with marigold garlands and fairy lights, round tables spread across the floor. Guests are clustered by who they know: at one table on the left, a noisy group of college friends in their twenties in bright kurtas taking selfies; at another, office colleagues in formal shirts and sarees chatting politely with plates of food; further right, a table of elderly relatives in silk and shawls; in a far corner, a group of children with balloons. Entering at the bottom of the frame through the main door is a young woman guest (late twenties, green lehenga, small clutch bag, slightly unsure smile), and a curved dotted arrow from her leads to the nearest table where faces look familiar, the college friends, who wave at her. Thin dashed rings radiate from her position to show distance to each table, closest ring touching the college table. Far in the background, the stage with the couple and a flower backdrop. A small inset bubble in a corner shows the same woman entering a hall where every table is full of strangers, yet the arrow still points to the closest one. Warm golden festive lighting. Labels: "QUERY" above the woman, "NEAREST" over the college-friends table.

key: A library where every book has been
name: ch08_library_floor_pin
alt: Books lie on a huge library floor grouped by topic; a reader drops a pin and a librarian picks the three nearest books.
scene: A high-angle view looking down onto the enormous polished floor of an old library hall, with tall arched windows and balconies of shelves around the edges. Instead of being shelved, books lie flat on the floor in loose islands grouped by topic: a cluster of cookbooks with vegetable covers, a cluster of cricket books with bats on the spines, a cluster of astronomy books with starry covers, a cluster of law books in maroon bindings. Near the centre, a schoolboy of about twelve in uniform and a backpack has just pushed a big red map pin into the floor beside the astronomy cluster, a small paper slip next to it reading "black holes?". A kindly librarian in her fifties (cardigan over a saree, glasses on a beaded chain) kneels beside the pin, picking up the three closest astronomy books, with three short dotted lines showing their distances to the pin. In the far background, a second, exhausted librarian walks with a measuring tape from book to book across the whole floor, a long winding path drawn behind him. Soft daylight streams through the tall windows, dust motes in the air, calm and scholarly. Labels: "QUERY" on the red pin, "TOP 3" above the kneeling librarian.

key: Asking a Mumbai auto driver for
name: ch08_auto_driver_wrong_city
alt: An auto-rickshaw driver used to Mumbai confidently points a lost traveller in a random direction on a Chennai street.
scene: An eye-level street scene in a south Indian city: a temple gopuram rises in the background, a filter-coffee stall with steel tumblers on the left, Tamil-style shop awnings and jasmine sellers along the pavement. In the centre, a yellow-and-black auto-rickshaw is parked at the kerb with a Mumbai-style driver leaning out (late forties, khaki uniform, thick moustache, betel-stained grin) who points emphatically with his whole arm toward the left, full of confidence. Beside the auto, a lost traveller (young man in a crumpled shirt, suitcase on wheels, holding a paper slip with a street address) follows the pointing arm with a hopeful face. Above the driver a thought bubble shows a small map of Mumbai's coastline with a local train, completely unrelated to the street he is standing on. A long curving dotted arrow from his finger wanders off into a maze of lanes and ends at a dead-end wall. A small inset bubble in the top corner shows a dial meter with a needle in a red zone marked with a line, hinting that a threshold could have stopped him. Bright, humid midday light, slightly comic. Labels: "OUT OF DOMAIN" above the auto, "STILL ANSWERS" next to the pointing arm.

key: writing one sticky note per chapter
name: ch08_sticky_note_per_chapter
alt: One thick book with a single vague sticky note on its cover beside the same book with a sticky note on every chapter.
scene: A split-panel close-up on a study desk, divided by a thin vertical line, the same thick 300-page hardback book in both halves lying on a wooden desk next to a cup of tea and a pencil. LEFT panel: one yellow sticky note is stuck on the front cover, covered in tiny cramped scribbles that trail off the edge, with only a vague word readable, "stuff". A young student in a hoodie and glasses frowns at it, scratching his head, a question mark floating above him; a thought bubble shows him trying to remember where something about refunds was. RIGHT panel: the same book stands upright with a neat rainbow of colourful sticky tabs poking out of the pages, one per chapter, each with a short readable word: "pricing", "refunds", "delivery". The same student pulls out the tab marked "refunds" and smiles as the book opens straight to the right page. A small inset at the bottom right shows an over-tabbed book bristling with hundreds of tiny tabs, one per sentence, looking like a hedgehog, with each tab torn from its meaning. Warm desk-lamp light, cosy and studious. Labels: "ONE CHUNK" over the left panel, "CHUNKS" over the right panel.

key: Mixing dal, kheer and pickle in one bowl
name: ch08_mixed_bowl_vs_katoris
alt: A muddy bowl of dal, kheer and pickle mixed together beside a thali with each dish in its own katori.
scene: A split-panel overhead view of a dining table covered in a banana-leaf-green tablecloth, divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a large steel bowl in which dal, kheer and red mango pickle have been stirred together into one brownish, murky mixture, a spoon standing in it; a man in his thirties in a checked shirt leans over it, wrinkling his nose, and a speech bubble from a child beside him asks "anything sweet?" while the man shrugs, unsure. Three small arrows from a yellow dal pot, a white kheer pot and a red pickle jar all pour into the single bowl. RIGHT panel: a round steel thali with three separate katoris, yellow dal, creamy white kheer with a few cashews and saffron strands, and glossy red pickle, plus a stack of rotis. The same child happily points straight at the kheer katori and smiles. Both panels share soft natural window light from the left, a homely lunchtime feeling with a steel water tumbler and a folded napkin. A small inset in the corner of the left panel shows a sign reading "meal?" with a thumbs-up, hinting that the mix is fine for a broad question. Labels: "AVERAGE" over the left panel, "SEPARATE" over the right panel.

key: Finding your friend in a crowd. In a
name: ch08_stadium_find_friend
alt: A woman checks every face in a small classroom, then at a stadium first goes to the right stand before scanning faces.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, the same young woman in both halves (mid-twenties, team jersey, cap, phone in hand). LEFT panel: a small classroom with about twenty students at wooden desks; dotted lines run from her eyes to every single face one by one as she walks the aisle, and her friend sits in the third row waving. RIGHT panel: a huge cricket stadium seen from above at night under floodlights, seating divided into coloured stands and lettered blocks, with signboards reading "NORTH STAND" and "BLOCK C". She first walks a dotted path straight to the North Stand, then scans only the faces in Block C, where her friend in a blue wig waves a flag. A tiny figure in Block F, also looking like her friend, is ignored, hinting she might miss someone who sat in the wrong block. In the corner, a ticketing kiosk with a turnstile shows people constantly arriving and leaving, with small in and out arrows. Crowd noise and colour fill the right half, while the left half feels quiet. Bright daylight on the left, dramatic floodlight on the right. Labels: "BRUTE FORCE" over the left panel, "APPROXIMATE" over the right panel.

key: Training a new waiter at a South Indian
name: ch08_waiter_coffee_orders
alt: A new waiter in a south Indian restaurant learns that two coffee orders mean the same small cup and a third is different.
scene: An eye-level view inside a bustling south Indian vegetarian restaurant with marble-topped tables, steel tumbler-and-dabara sets and a wall clock. On the left, a nervous new waiter (about eighteen, white shirt, white veshti, notepad in hand) stands between two tables. Three customers' speech bubbles rise toward him: "one by two", "half coffee" and "filter large". In the first half of the picture he looks confused, with all three bubbles drawn identically in the same grey. On the right side, an older head waiter (sixties, grey moustache, towel on shoulder, kind but firm) leans in and taps the notepad, correcting him. Above the young waiter, a cork board shows a week of small sticky notes with ticks and crosses, showing days of correction. At the bottom of the frame, his tray holds the result: the first two bubbles now connect with dotted lines to two identical small coffee tumblers placed close together, while the third connects to a large tumbler set clearly apart. Steam rises from the cups, sunlight slants through high windows, busy morning tiffin rush. Labels: "SAME" between the two small tumblers, "DIFFERENT" beside the large tumbler.

key: A cricket selection process. District
name: ch08_district_trials_selectors
alt: Thousands of players at district trials are cut down to thirty, whom national selectors then watch bat and rank one by one.
scene: A two-part scene flowing left to right across a single wide frame. LEFT: a dusty district ground crowded with hundreds of young cricketers in mismatched whites and coloured caps, queuing in long lines while a local official with a clipboard and a quick glance at a printed stats sheet waves most of them away; a funnel drawn over this area narrows the crowd to a short line of thirty players walking toward the right. One talented-looking boy is left behind outside the funnel, sitting dejected on his kit bag with a small star above his head that nobody notices. RIGHT: a lush green stadium net session where three national selectors in blazers and sunglasses sit on chairs under an umbrella, watching one batsman play a crisp cover drive; they hold a ranked list on a clipboard, moving names up and down with arrows. Behind them the thirty players wait their turn in a neat line. Bright morning sunlight, the left side chaotic and fast, the right side focused and careful. Labels: "STAGE 1" above the funnel, "RERANKER" above the selectors.

key: Cooking at home instead of ordering
name: ch08_home_kitchen_vs_restaurant
alt: A woman cooks in her own kitchen with her own ingredients while a delivery rider waits at a restaurant collecting a fee.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a cosy home kitchen with a two-burner gas stove, spice box open with turmeric, chilli and mustard seeds, and fresh vegetables on a chopping board. A woman in her thirties (cotton kurta, hair tied up, apron) stirs a pot, choosing a jar from a neat shelf of labelled ingredient jars; a closed window with a little padlock on the latch shows that nothing leaves the kitchen. A shopping list and a recipe notebook lie open on the counter, signalling more setup. RIGHT panel: the bright counter of a restaurant with a uniformed chef in a tall white hat plating a beautiful dish, a delivery rider in a helmet waiting with an insulated bag, and a small bill on the counter with a coin symbol showing a per-order fee; a dotted arrow carries a sealed parcel and the customer's address card out of the door into the city. The chef's dish looks noticeably fancier than the home pot, hinting the professional may simply be better. Soft evening light in the home kitchen, bright commercial light in the restaurant. Labels: "LOCAL" over the left panel, "API" over the right panel, "FEE" on the bill.

key: An answer key for a quiz. The archive
name: ch08_quiz_answer_key
alt: A teacher holds an answer key listing the right textbook pages while two students compare their lists of pages.
scene: An eye-level view inside a sunlit school classroom with a green chalkboard and wooden benches. At the centre, a teacher in her forties (cotton saree, spectacles, red pen tucked in her bun) stands at her desk holding up a sheet titled "KEY" showing short lines of question numbers paired with page numbers, a thick textbook open beside her. On the left bench, a boy in a white school shirt and striped tie holds up his notebook listing three page numbers for question one, two of which match the key and get green ticks. On the right bench, a girl with two plaits holds up her own list of three pages, with one green tick, one red cross and one grey question mark next to a page the key does not mention at all. Dotted lines connect each student's list to the teacher's key. On the chalkboard behind them, three quiz questions are written in short chalk lines. A small inset bubble near the question mark shows that page in the textbook actually containing the answer, with a little lightbulb, suggesting it was right but simply never judged. Warm morning light through tall windows, cheerful exam mood. Labels: "ANSWER KEY" on the teacher's sheet, "SYSTEM A" and "SYSTEM B" above the two students.

key: If your best batsman (the relevant one)
name: ch08_batting_order_rank
alt: A team's star batsman opening the innings earns full marks, while the same star batting at three after two ducks earns less.
scene: A split-panel illustration of the same cricket ground's scoreboard area and pitch, divided by a thin vertical line, with a star batsman in both halves (late twenties, helmet with a green grille, padded up, gleaming bat). LEFT panel: the star walks out first through the pavilion gate, with a small number "1" on his back, while a coach in a tracksuit on the boundary holds up a scorecard with a large gold star. RIGHT panel: two dejected batsmen trudge back past the gate, each with a duck egg drawn above his head, and only then does the star walk out with a number "3" on his back; the same coach holds a scorecard with a smaller silver star, a little minus sign beside it. In the stands behind the right panel, several spectators are already leaving their seats and walking toward the exits, hinting that many people never stay for the later batsmen. A big electronic scoreboard looms in the background of both halves. Bright afternoon sun, long shadows, crowd in coloured flags. Labels: "RANK 1" over the left panel, "RANK 3" over the right panel.

key: A customer-care agent at a bank. You ask
name: ch08_bank_agent_statement
alt: A bank customer-care agent pulls up a customer's statements on screen and points at the exact line while explaining a charge.
scene: An over-the-shoulder view from behind a customer seated at a bank's customer-care desk, looking toward the agent and her monitor. The customer, a retired man in his sixties (half-sleeve shirt, spectacles, a folded passbook in his hand, puzzled frown), leans forward. Across the desk, the agent, a young woman in her late twenties in a crisp formal uniform blouse with a name badge and headset, has swivelled her large monitor toward him. On screen are three stacked statement pages, and she points with a pen at one highlighted row, while a short speech bubble from her says "this line, 12 March". A dotted arrow runs from a filing-cabinet icon in the corner of the monitor into the three pages, showing they were fetched first, and a second arrow runs from the highlighted row to her speech bubble. Behind them, the bank floor has a token display board, a queue of customers on steel chairs and a potted plant. A tiny inset bubble in the upper corner shows the screen displaying a different customer's photo, with the agent noticing and frowning, hinting that she would catch the mix-up. Even, cool office lighting, reassuring and professional. Labels: "RETRIEVE" on the arrow into the pages, "CITATION" on the highlighted row.

key: A news report where every number has
name: ch08_news_footnotes
alt: A reader taps a tiny footnote on a news article and a press-release sheet unfolds beside the number.
scene: A close, slightly high-angle view of a woman in her thirties (office kurta, reading glasses pushed up on her head) sitting at a breakfast table with chai and toast, reading a large printed newspaper page held open in front of her. The article has a few bold numbers in its columns, such as "42%" and "1.2 lakh", and beside each number sits a tiny circled footnote marker. Her index finger taps one marker, and from it a dotted line unfolds out of the page into a floating sheet of paper, a press release with a letterhead and a paragraph with the same number underlined. Further right, a second dotted line from another footnote leads to a press release whose letterhead is smudged and whose number is circled in red with a small question mark, hinting that the source itself may be wrong even though the footnote points to it faithfully. In the background, a kitchen window with morning light, a pressure cooker on the stove and a calendar on the wall. Warm, calm morning light; the mood is curious and trusting. Labels: "SOURCE" above the clean press release, "CITATION" beside the footnote marker.

key: Handing a junior colleague a printout
name: ch08_two_juniors_printout
alt: A manager hands two juniors the same printout; one quotes it faithfully, the other adds his own theory.
scene: An eye-level view of an open-plan office corner with two desks side by side. At the left edge, a senior manager in her forties (blazer over a kurta, lanyard, coffee mug) has just handed an identical printed sheet to each of two junior colleagues. CENTRE: a neat young woman junior (late twenties, hair in a bun, glasses) holds the printout up beside her laptop, typing a reply, with a dotted arrow running from a highlighted sentence on the page straight into her email draft; her speech bubble holds a pair of quote marks around a short line, showing she is quoting it. RIGHT: a chatty young man junior (curly hair, loosened tie, leaning back in his chair, hands waving expressively) has his printout lying ignored on the desk, while his speech bubble grows into a big cloud with a spinning planet, a lightbulb and a question mark, an elaborate theory of his own. The manager glances at him, eyebrow raised. Behind them a whiteboard with sticky notes and a window showing a city skyline. Bright midday office light, light comedic tone. Labels: "GROUNDED" above the woman, "MAKES IT UP" above the man.

key: Calling a helpline and telling a long
name: ch08_helpline_three_words
alt: A caller tells a long rambling story on the phone while a helpline operator types only three words into the system.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: in a cluttered living room, an animated grandmother in her seventies (cotton saree, bindi, reading glasses on a chain) holds a landline phone to her ear with one hand while gesturing widely with the other; her speech bubble spills out in a long winding ribbon full of tiny doodles: a beach, a holiday photo, a grandson, a documentary on TV, and finally a small dolphin. RIGHT panel: in a call centre cubicle with a headset, a young operator in his twenties (company polo shirt, ID card, attentive face) listens and types; on his monitor the search box contains just three words, "dolphin habitat query". A dotted arrow runs from the long ribbon into the narrow search box, which is drawn like a funnel that squeezes the ribbon into three words. A small doodle of the grandson's school project falls out of the funnel onto the floor unnoticed, hinting a detail that mattered was dropped. Soft homely lamp light on the left, cool blue screen light on the right. Labels: "LONG QUESTION" over the left panel, "REWRITE" over the right panel.

key: Comparing two phones for a friend: you
name: ch08_two_specs_compare
alt: A young man looks up two phones in two separate searches and writes a comparison combining both.
scene: A close, eye-level view of a young man in his twenties (oversized hoodie, earphones around his neck, focused face) sitting at a small study table with a laptop. The laptop screen is split into two side-by-side windows, each showing a large picture of a different generic smartphone, one silver and one black, with a short column of spec icons beneath (camera, battery, storage) and no readable brand. Two separate dotted arrows lead from two small search boxes at the top of the screen, one into each window, showing two separate look-ups. In front of the laptop, he writes on a notepad a two-column comparison with a tick and a cross under each phone, with arrows from both windows converging onto the notepad. Leaning over his shoulder, his friend (a girl in a college T-shirt holding a cardboard box with no logo, curious smile) waits for his verdict. Behind them, a wall pinned with posters and a window showing a twilight sky. A tiny inset bubble in the corner shows a single page that already contains a ready-made comparison table, with a small lightbulb. Warm desk-lamp light mixed with the blue glow of the screen. Labels: "QUERY 1" and "QUERY 2" above the two windows, "COMBINE" on the notepad.

key: Planning a trip: first you search
name: ch08_trip_planning_hops
alt: A traveller first finds a list of three hill stations, then searches homestays for each one in turn.
scene: A wide view of a young couple in their late twenties sitting cross-legged on a living-room floor surrounded by travel material, planning a holiday, drawn as a left-to-right journey of steps. The woman (loose T-shirt, hair clip, pen in mouth) holds a tablet showing three postcard-sized pictures of misty hills, tea gardens and a lake, with short captions "Coorg", "Ooty" and "Chikmagalur". From each of those three postcards, a dotted arrow leads to the right, to three separate brochure piles on the floor, each showing a cosy cottage with a sloping roof and smoke from a chimney, which the man (glasses, kurta, laptop on his knees) is opening one by one. A big folded road map lies between them with the three places circled. In a small inset bubble at the top right, the first step goes wrong: the tablet shows beaches and palm trees instead of hills, and three dotted arrows still faithfully lead to three beach-shack brochures, with the couple not noticing. Late-afternoon light through a window with a potted money plant, relaxed holiday-planning mood. Labels: "HOP 1" above the tablet, "HOP 2" above the brochure piles.

key: The reception desk at a government
name: ch08_reception_counters
alt: A receptionist in a government office directs one visitor to counter 3 for passports and another to counter 7 for ration cards.
scene: A wide, eye-level view inside a government office hall with a long row of numbered service counters behind glass, ceiling fans, a token display board and rows of steel chairs. In the foreground centre stands a reception desk with a middle-aged receptionist (maroon cardigan, spectacles, pen behind her ear, brisk expression) pointing with both hands in two directions at once. On her left, a young man holding a blue folder with a small passport symbol follows her pointing finger toward a counter with a big painted "3" above it. On her right, an elderly woman in a nine-yard saree holding a pink card follows the other pointing arm toward a counter painted "7". Dotted arrows trace both routes across the floor. Further right, a third visitor, a puzzled businessman with two different folders under each arm, stands between counters 3 and 7 with arrows splitting toward both, hinting that some questions need two counters. Dusty afternoon light through tall barred windows, orderly bureaucratic bustle. Labels: "ROUTER" above the receptionist.

key: A personal assistant who starts by just
name: ch08_assistant_four_stages
alt: The same personal assistant shown in four stages: reading files aloud, picking a drawer, looking up next steps, then booking a cab.
scene: A four-panel horizontal strip, left to right, the same personal assistant in every panel: a capable woman in her thirties in a smart kurta with a notebook, and her employer, a busy executive in a suit. PANEL ONE: the executive hands her a stack of files and she reads aloud from the top page. PANEL TWO: she stands at a tall filing cabinet with labelled drawers, confidently pulling open just one drawer. PANEL THREE: she sits with an open file and a notepad, drawing an arrow from one page to a second file she is now reaching for, a thought bubble with a small chain of two linked boxes. PANEL FOUR: she is on the phone booking a cab, while sending an email on a laptop, a small car icon and envelope icon flying out; beside her a small padlock and a confirmation checkbox sit on the laptop, and the executive gives a thumbs-up to approve. Thin dotted arrows connect the panels to show progression. Clean office lighting, growing sense of capability from panel to panel. Labels: "RAG" over panel one, "ROUTING" over panel two, "AGENT" over panel four.

key: Checking a college assignment with
name: ch08_assignment_citation_check
alt: An examiner checks a student's assignment, matching each claim to its reference book and ticking or crossing it.
scene: A close, slightly high-angle view of a college examiner's desk in a staff room at night. A senior professor in his fifties (grey beard, kurta with a shawl, reading glasses low on his nose, focused expression) has a stapled student assignment open in front of him, its paragraphs marked with small superscript numbers. Around the assignment, three reference books lie open at bookmarked pages. Dotted lines run from claims in the assignment to the matching passages in the books. One line ends with a green tick where the book says the same thing; another line ends with a red cross where the book page talks about something else entirely; and one claim in the assignment has no line at all, circled in red with a question mark. A small red pen, a steel cup of tea and a desk lamp complete the desk. In the background, shelves of thick textbooks and a wall clock showing late hours. A tiny inset bubble shows a small robot judge in the same chair, wearing the same pair of glasses as the student it grades, hinting at shared blind spots. Warm lamp light in a dark room, careful and scrupulous mood. Labels: "RECALL" by the circled claim, "PRECISION" by the red cross, "FAITHFUL" by the green tick.

key: A phone call versus a video call with
name: ch09_phone_vs_video_call
alt: A mother on a voice call hears only words, while on a video call she sees her son's tired face and instantly knows.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, the same pair in both halves: a mother in her late fifties in a small-town home (cotton saree, bindi, reading glasses on her head, sitting on a sofa with a crocheted cover) and her son, a young man in his twenties in a hostel room in a big city, with messy hair, dark circles under his eyes and a crumpled T-shirt, a pile of books and an empty instant-noodle cup on his desk. LEFT panel: they talk on a plain voice call; she holds the phone to her ear smiling, while his speech bubble says "all fine, Ma"; she sees nothing of his room, which is drawn faded on his side of the line. RIGHT panel: the same conversation on a video call, her phone held out in front of her showing his exhausted face clearly in the screen; her eyebrows shoot up in concern and her own speech bubble says "you have not slept!". A small inset bubble in the bottom corner shows her trying to hold up a plate of food to the camera while the son's side can only answer back with words. Warm evening lamplight at home, cool tube light in the hostel. Labels: "TEXT ONLY" over the left panel, "MULTIMODAL" over the right panel.

key: A sorting clerk at a post office who
name: ch09_parcels_in_envelopes
alt: A post-office clerk who only reads envelopes sorts parcels too, once each parcel is slipped into a labelled envelope.
scene: An eye-level view inside the back room of an old Indian post office with wooden pigeonhole racks, jute mail sacks and a ceiling fan. On the right, a veteran sorting clerk in his fifties (khaki uniform, thick moustache, half-sleeve shirt, rubber stamp tucked in his pocket) is sitting on a stool, quickly reading envelopes and flicking them into pigeonholes, a smooth practised motion shown by curved arrows. On the left, a young assistant (early twenties, rolled sleeves, keen expression) stands at a table where an awkward pile of odd-shaped parcels sits, wrapped in brown paper and string. She is slipping each parcel into a large white envelope and writing a short code on its front, then passing it along a little conveyor of hands toward the clerk, who sorts it exactly like any letter without changing his method. Beside her, a small cutting mat shows one parcel being divided into neat square pieces before wrapping. A small inset bubble near her table shows the envelope's code being worked out freshly with a tiny gear, not looked up in a dictionary. Dusty shafts of afternoon light, steady and industrious. Labels: "PATCH" on a parcel, "ENVELOPE" on the stack of envelopes, "SAME CLERK" above the old clerk.

key: A UPI QR code at a kirana shop. Every
name: ch09_qr_scanning_rule
alt: A customer scans different QR codes at three shops with the same phone, each turning into a usable payment ID.
scene: A wide street-level view of three small shops side by side in an Indian market lane: a kirana store with sacks of rice and dal, a vegetable cart piled with tomatoes and okra, and a tiny tea stall with a kettle on a stove. Each shop has a laminated QR code stuck to its counter or cart, and each QR pattern is visibly different. In the foreground, the same customer appears three times walking left to right (a young woman in a cotton kurta and jeans, cloth tote bag, phone in hand), holding her phone up to each QR code in turn. From each QR, a beam of light enters the phone and comes out the other side as a short tidy ID tag hanging on a little string, every tag a different code but the same shape. Above the phone in each case floats the same small gear symbol, showing it is one identical rule applied every time. A small inset bubble at the top corner shows two very similar tea-stall photos turning into two tags of nearly the same colour, while a vegetable photo becomes a very different colour. Bright morning market light, busy and cheerful, marigold strings over the shops. Labels: "PROJECTION" on the gear, "SAME RULE" above the phone in the middle.

key: A wedding photo album where every photo
name: ch09_album_name_tags
alt: A wedding album where every photo has a name tag beside it; looking up a name or a face leads to the same page.
scene: A close, slightly high-angle view of a thick red velvet wedding album lying open on a carved wooden table in a living room. Each page holds glossy photos of guests in festive clothes, and stuck right next to every photo is a small handwritten name tag, for example "Sharma aunty" beside a smiling lady in a gold-bordered silk saree. Two family members lean over the album from either side. On the left, a teenage girl in a kurta reads names off a guest list and runs her finger down to the tag; on the right, an elderly uncle in a Nehru jacket holds a loose printed photo of the same aunty and compares faces. Two dotted arrows, one from the girl's guest list and one from the uncle's loose photo, both arrive at the same album page and the same photo-and-tag pair. On the facing page, a photo of a dog and a photo of a puppy sit together under a single tag, shown cosily side by side. Afternoon sunlight falls through lace curtains, with a cup of tea and a box of sweets on the table; a warm nostalgic mood. Labels: "TEXT" above the girl, "IMAGE" above the uncle, "SHARED SPACE" across the album page.

key: A railway enquiry clerk who has never
name: ch09_parcel_three_labels
alt: A railway parcel clerk is handed a parcel and three handwritten labels and points at the label that fits best.
scene: An eye-level view across the counter of a railway parcel office with a weighing scale, a ledger and shelves of tied-up parcels behind. The clerk, a sharp-eyed woman in her forties (railway uniform blouse, spectacles, hair in a neat bun), sits behind the counter. A customer, a farmer in his fifties in a white kurta-pyjama and a towel over his shoulder, has placed a lumpy parcel on the counter with the corner of a cricket bat handle poking out of the brown paper. Beside the parcel he lays three hand-written cardboard labels he made on the spot: "BOOKS", "SPORTS" and "FRUIT". The clerk taps the "SPORTS" label confidently, and a dotted arrow runs from the visible bat handle to that card, while the other two cards stay faded. Behind her on the wall, old public signboards and posters she has learned from are pinned up, with simple icons of a bat, a book and a mango. A small inset bubble shows a strange industrial metal part on the counter and the clerk squinting with a question mark above her head. Bright daylight from the platform outside, steam engine posters on the wall. Labels: "ZERO-SHOT" above the clerk.

key: Making chai from scratch (boil water
name: ch09_chai_scratch_vs_premix
alt: One person makes chai step by step on a stove while another makes the same cup from a premix sachet.
scene: A split-panel illustration of a small home kitchen, divided by a thin vertical line, both halves ending with an identical steaming glass of milky chai on the counter. LEFT panel: a middle-aged man in a vest and lungi stands at a gas stove with a dented saucepan, surrounded by a row of steps laid out left to right: a steel jug of water, a tin of tea leaves, a knob of ginger on a grater, a packet of milk, a sugar jar, and a strainer held over a glass, with small numbered circles 1 to 6 floating above each. He is busy, sleeves rolled, a towel on his shoulder. RIGHT panel: a young woman in office clothes and a lanyard tears open a single sachet over a glass while a kettle pours hot water, one quick motion, with a small circle numbered 1 above it; she checks her watch, relaxed. In a small inset bubble on the right panel, she frowns at the sachet, wishing she could change only the ginger, while an arrow points back toward the left panel. Early-morning light through a kitchen window with a steel dish rack. Labels: "STEP BY STEP" over the left panel, "PIPELINE" over the right panel.

key: Connecting a new metro line to an old
name: ch09_metro_foot_bridge
alt: A single foot-over-bridge connects an old railway station to a new metro station while both keep running.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated view across a city at dusk. On the left stands an old colonial-style railway station with a red brick facade, a big clock and a long train pulling into the platform, passengers with suitcases and coolies in red shirts. On the right rises a sleek new elevated metro station of glass and concrete with a shiny metro train gliding in. Neither building is touched: no scaffolding, no cranes. Between them, a single new foot-over-bridge with a steel truss stretches across a busy road, and a line of commuters walk across it in both directions. At the middle of the bridge, a small booth houses a uniformed helper who hands each crossing person a translated card, turning a rail ticket into a metro token, shown with a small swap arrow. Below the bridge, autos, buses and scooters stream along the road, unaffected. Streetlights glow and the sky fades from orange to purple. Calm, efficient urban mood. Labels: "IMAGE ENCODER" over the old station, "LLM" over the metro station, "Q-FORMER" on the bridge.

key: Training a new tour guide at Hampi
name: ch09_hampi_guide_three_tests
alt: A trainee tour guide among ancient stone ruins faces three tests: matching photos to cards, saying yes or no, and describing a photo.
scene: A wide view of an ancient south Indian ruin site at golden hour, with huge granite boulders, a carved stone chariot and pillared temple halls in the background. In the foreground, a young trainee tour guide (early twenties, cap, khaki shirt with a guide badge, satchel over shoulder) appears three times from left to right, each in a different test, with an older senior guide in a white shirt and spectacles holding a clipboard. LEFT: the trainee kneels at a flat rock spread with photos and description cards, sliding each card next to its matching photo. CENTRE: the senior guide holds up one photo of a stone chariot and one card; the trainee gives a thumbs-up, and a second card with a thumbs-down lies aside. RIGHT: the trainee holds a single photo of a pillared hall and speaks to a small group of tourists in hats, a speech bubble showing a short sketch of pillars. Dotted arrows connect the three stations. Warm golden sunlight, long shadows across the boulders, educational and lively. Labels: "MATCH", "YES OR NO" and "DESCRIBE" above the three stations.

key: Sending a photo to a friend on
name: ch09_photo_with_voice_note
alt: A photo sent alone in a chat leaves the friend confused, while the same photo with a voice note placed before a question makes sense.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, each panel showing a close view of a phone held in a friend's hand: a young woman in her twenties sitting in a college canteen with a plate of samosas and a cutting chai. LEFT panel: the chat on her screen shows only a photo of a crowded street-market stall with no caption, followed by a question bubble "what is this?"; she squints, puzzled, with a question mark above her head. RIGHT panel: the same chat, but now the photo is followed by a voice-note bubble with a little waveform, drawn in shimmering, unusual colours that do not look like any letters, sitting right before the question bubble; the friend smiles, nodding, with a lightbulb above her. A dotted arrow from the photo flows into the waveform and then into the question. The voice-note bubble has a small alien-looking script floating above it instead of words, hinting it is not human language. Busy canteen background with students and a menu board. Bright daylight. Labels: "NO CONTEXT" over the left panel, "SOFT PROMPT" on the voice note.

key: A restaurant kitchen. The processor is
name: ch09_kitchen_prep_counter
alt: At a restaurant prep counter a helper washes and cuts a whole pumpkin into standard cubes before passing them to the cook.
scene: A wide, eye-level view of a restaurant kitchen arranged from left to right. LEFT: a delivery crate holds raw, unwashed vegetables, including a big whole muddy pumpkin, a bunch of spinach with roots, and unpeeled onions. CENTRE: at a stainless-steel prep counter, a kitchen helper (young man, hairnet, apron, rubber gloves) washes, peels and dices everything into identical neat cubes using a square cube-sized wooden guide frame; a tray of perfectly uniform cubes sits beside him. RIGHT: at the stove, a confident cook in a white chef's jacket and a red bandana tosses those cubes into a large kadhai with flames rising, cooking smoothly. Dotted arrows run from crate to counter to stove. A small inset bubble at the top shows the same square guide frame forcing a long, thin drumstick vegetable into cube pieces, crushing it slightly, with a sad face drawn on one piece, hinting that fixed rules can damage odd inputs. Bright overhead kitchen lights, steam and clatter, efficient mood. Labels: "PROCESSOR" above the prep counter, "MODEL" above the cook.

key: new intern who has seen thousands
name: ch09_intern_wedding_captions
alt: A photography intern writes the same quick caption for a thousand wedding photos but is lost when asked to identify a specific cousin.
scene: An eye-level view inside a small photo-studio office with framed wedding portraits on the walls and a large monitor showing a grid of hundreds of thumbnail photos. A young intern in his early twenties (round glasses, graphic T-shirt, headphones around his neck) sits at the desk typing at lightning speed; on the screen, a caption field under each photo repeats "bride and groom on stage", and a big pile of printed photos on the desk grows into a finished stack labelled with sticky notes. Standing behind him, the senior photographer, a woman in her forties with a camera strap around her neck and a dupatta, asks a question in a speech bubble: "Ravi's cousin from Pune?". The intern turns toward her with a completely blank face and a big question mark above his head. On a shelf behind him, stacks of public wedding magazines show where he learned what weddings look like. A small inset at the corner shows a black inkblot image on the screen with the caption box confidently filled in with a bat symbol. Soft studio lighting with a warm glow from the monitor. Labels: "CAPTIONS" on the stack of photos, "UNKNOWN" beside the question mark.

key: learning to drive a hired cab
name: ch10_cab_to_mechanic
alt: A driver first learns and drives a hired cab, then takes it to a mechanic who tunes the engine for local roads.
scene: A two-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, the same driver in both halves: a young woman in her late twenties (jeans, cotton shirt, sunglasses pushed into her hair, determined smile). LEFT panel: she sits behind the wheel of a yellow-and-black taxi on a city road, an older instructor beside her pointing at the dashboard gauges; through the windscreen, a busy road with buses and a flyover shows her driving it places. RIGHT panel: the same taxi sits in a small roadside garage with its bonnet open; a mechanic in his forties (oil-stained blue overalls, cap, spanner in hand) is leaning deep into the engine, tightening something, while she watches with arms folded. On the garage wall hangs a hand-drawn map of her local area showing potholed lanes and steep slopes, and a dotted arrow runs from the map into the engine. Small floating icons above the engine show the car's attention shifting from a highway sign to a pothole sign. Bright midday light on the left, warm dim garage light with a hanging bulb on the right. Labels: "USE" over the left panel, "TUNE" over the right panel.

key: Think of a kirana shopkeeper arranging
name: ch10_two_shelf_rules
alt: Two kirana shops stock the same products, one arranging shelves by category and the other by price band.
scene: A split-panel illustration showing the inside of two small kirana shops side by side, divided by a thin vertical line, with exactly the same products in each: soaps, packets of dal, biscuits, cooking oil bottles and toothpaste. LEFT panel: an older shopkeeper (white kurta, round glasses, grey moustache) stacks his shelves by category; one shelf holds only soaps of all sizes, the next only dal packets, the next only oil bottles, each shelf with a small hand-written tag such as "soaps" and "dal". RIGHT panel: a young shopkeeper (T-shirt, gelled hair, calculator in hand) arranges the same items by price; a cheap soap, a small dal packet and a biscuit packet sit together on one shelf under a big price tag "under 50", while expensive oil and premium soap share a top shelf. A single soap bar is highlighted in both panels with a dotted circle, showing it sits next to very different neighbours in each shop. Both shops have open shutters facing a street with a cycle passing by. Warm evening light from hanging bulbs. Labels: "BY CATEGORY" over the left panel, "BY PRICE" over the right panel.

key: A cricket coach teaching a new selector
name: ch10_two_bowlers_side_by_side
alt: A cricket coach shows a new selector a fast bowler and a spinner side by side, pointing at run-up speed and wrist position.
scene: A wide view of cricket practice nets at an academy ground in the morning. In the foreground, an experienced coach in his fifties (tracksuit, cap, whistle around his neck) stands beside a young new selector (early thirties, polo shirt, notebook in hand, attentive). The coach points at two bowlers running in on parallel pitches at the same moment. LEFT pitch: a tall fast bowler mid-stride with a long, explosive run-up, dust kicking up, speed lines behind him, his wrist upright behind the ball. RIGHT pitch: a slim spinner with a short, gentle run-up, wrist cocked sideways, ball drifting slowly. Dotted callout lines from the coach's finger highlight the two run-ups and the two wrists, with small close-up circles around each wrist. In a small inset bubble near the selector, a lone bowler stands with a vague description above him, a strong arm icon that fits both men equally, and a question mark. Bright morning sun, green grass, nets and a pavilion in the background, focused coaching mood. Labels: "POSITIVE" above the fast bowler, "NEGATIVE" above the spinner.

key: Twins at an exam centre answering
name: ch10_twins_exam_centre
alt: Identical twins at an exam centre answer different question papers, and an examiner compares how similar their answers are.
scene: An eye-level view inside a quiet exam hall with rows of wooden desks, a wall clock and a ceiling fan. In the centre, two identical twin boys (about sixteen, same school uniform, same haircut, same thoughtful frown) sit at neighbouring desks writing. A faint glowing thread connects the tops of their heads to a single brain-shaped cloud above them, showing they share one mind. Each has a different question paper in front of him, one reading "sentence A" and the other "sentence B". At the front of the hall, an examiner in a cardigan and spectacles holds both answer sheets side by side against the window light, comparing them with a protractor-like dial gauge that shows an angle between two arrows. On the right edge of the frame, a small inset bubble shows the same scene later: only one of the boys sits at a desk, answering the two papers one after the other, with a stack of papers on his left and right. Soft morning daylight, hushed exam atmosphere, invigilator walking in the background. Labels: "SHARED WEIGHTS" on the brain cloud, "COSINE" on the dial gauge.

key: Opening a new tiffin service: you need
name: ch10_tiffin_service_three_needs
alt: A new tiffin service kitchen with raw ingredients, a cook at a stove and a tasting panel of three people.
scene: A wide, slightly high-angle view of a small home-run tiffin-service kitchen arranged left to right. LEFT: a table piled with fresh ingredients, bags of rice, lentils, onions, tomatoes, green chillies and coriander bunches, with a woman in her forties (cotton saree, sleeves tucked) checking them off a list. CENTRE: a stove with three burners, a pressure cooker whistling and a big pot of sambar, with a young cook (apron, hairnet) following a handwritten recipe card pinned to the wall. RIGHT: at a small table, a tasting panel of three people, an office worker with a lanyard, a college student and a retired gentleman, each sampling from a steel tiffin box and holding up score cards. A row of stacked steel tiffin carriers with nametags waits by the door for delivery. A small inset bubble near the tasting panel shows actual customers in an office later frowning at the same food, hinting the panel may not match them. Bright morning light streaming through a window, steam rising, a busy and hopeful start-up mood. Labels: "DATA" over the ingredients, "MODEL" over the stove, "EVALUATION" over the tasting panel.

key: A railway enquiry clerk checking
name: ch10_chart_entailment_check
alt: A railway clerk checks three statements about a passenger against the reservation chart: same fact, contradiction, or not stated.
scene: An eye-level view of a railway platform beside a long-distance express train, where a reservation chart is pasted on the side of a coach. A railway clerk in her forties (navy railway uniform, spectacles, pen behind her ear, sharp attentive expression) stands with one finger on a name on the chart. Three people approach her from the right, each with a speech bubble. The first, a porter in a red shirt, holds up a small picture of a train heading to a city skyline; she gives a green tick. The second, a young man, holds up a picture of an aeroplane heading to the sea; she gives a red cross. The third, an elderly lady, holds up a picture of a window seat with a little heart; the clerk shrugs with a grey dash, since the chart says nothing about it. Each response is shown as a small coloured circle above her head connected to its speaker by a dotted line. Behind them, the train's coach number plates, a tea vendor with a kettle and a bustling platform. Bright afternoon light under a tin platform roof. Labels: "ENTAILMENT" by the tick, "CONTRADICTION" by the cross, "NEUTRAL" by the dash.

key: STSB is a single unit test; MTEB is
name: ch10_unit_test_vs_board_exam
alt: A student finishes a single short class test easily, beside the same student in a huge board exam hall with many subjects and a timer.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, the same student in both halves: a girl of about sixteen in a school uniform with two plaits and a pencil behind her ear. LEFT panel: a small classroom where she sits alone with a single short sheet of paper on one topic, done already, leaning back with a relaxed smile; a teacher at the door holds a single mark slip. RIGHT panel: a vast board exam hall with hundreds of desks in rows stretching into the distance, invigilators walking the aisles, and on her desk a thick stack of papers with tabs for different subjects, small icons for sorting, grouping and searching, and a few sheets in other scripts for different languages. A large ticking timer clock sits on her desk, and she is writing fast with a focused frown. A small inset bubble at the bottom right shows her later in an office cubicle facing a strange new problem on a laptop, with a question mark, hinting the exam does not cover her company's own questions. Bright tube light in both halves. Labels: "STSB" over the left panel, "MTEB" over the right panel.

key: Same student, same textbook, different
name: ch10_three_exam_formats
alt: The same student with the same textbook faces three exam formats: category essay, fill-in-the-score, and pick one from many.
scene: A three-panel horizontal strip, left to right, the same student in each panel: a young man in his late teens with a wrinkled shirt, ink-stained fingers, and the same thick textbook on his desk. PANEL ONE: he writes an essay, and a teacher stamps one of three category boxes at the top of his paper, marked with three small coloured squares. PANEL TWO: he fills in a single number on a slider scale from zero to one, with a dotted arrow pointing at the mark he chose. PANEL THREE: a sheet with 32 small answer cards laid out in a grid; he circles exactly one card that matches the question, the rest faded. In each panel, a small thought bubble above his head shows his study notes shaped differently: sorted into bins, arranged on a line, and pinned to a matching partner. Thin dotted arrows connect the textbook in each panel to the different note shapes. Warm classroom light through a window, a chalkboard in the background, a studious and slightly anxious mood. Labels: "SOFTMAX" over panel one, "COSINE" over panel two, "MNR" over panel three.

key: Training from scratch is raising a cook
name: ch10_raise_vs_hire_cook
alt: A child learning to cook over many years beside an experienced cook being taught a restaurant menu in a week.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a timeline of a home kitchen across many years, drawn as three overlapping moments, a small child of five on a stool stirring a pot with a parent's help, the same child at twelve rolling rotis, and finally a young adult cook frying pakoras; a long calendar with many pages flipping above them shows the years passing. RIGHT panel: a restaurant kitchen where an experienced cook in his forties (white chef's coat, salt-and-pepper beard, confident posture) studies a laminated menu card held by the restaurant owner, a woman in a crisp kurta; a small desk calendar shows just one week. Above the cook's head floats a thought bubble with his old habit, a big ladle of ghee being poured, and a little red cross, while the owner points to her menu's lighter version. Steam and spice jars fill both halves. Warm golden light on the left, brighter commercial light on the right. Labels: "FROM SCRATCH" over the left panel, "FINE-TUNE" over the right panel.

key: A trained Carnatic singer learning
name: ch10_singer_new_composition
alt: A trained Carnatic singer quickly learns a new piece, while a beginner first does basic voice training.
scene: A split-panel illustration of a music room with a carpet, a harmonium and a tanpura leaning on the wall, divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: an accomplished singer in her thirties (silk saree, jasmine in her hair, sitting cross-legged with poise) reads a new composition from a notebook on a small wooden stand and sings confidently, musical notes flowing from her in smooth curves; a violinist accompanies her. A faint second notebook on a shelf behind her has the same title, hinting she has sung this piece before. RIGHT panel: a nervous beginner, a teenage boy in a kurta, sits before a strict elderly guru with a white beard and a shawl; the boy does basic scale exercises, with jagged, uneven notes coming out of his mouth, while the guru taps the rhythm on his knee. A big stack of exercise books sits next to the boy and only a thin new composition sheet. Soft morning light through a window with a neem tree outside, devotional and calm mood. Labels: "PRETRAINED" over the left panel, "BEGINNER" over the right panel.

key: A senior CA (chartered accountant)
name: ch10_ca_junior_checklist
alt: A senior accountant checks a hundred invoices, trains a junior who checks four hundred more, and their habits become a branch checklist.
scene: A wide view of an accounting office drawn as a left-to-right flow. LEFT: a senior chartered accountant in her fifties (spectacles, crisp cotton saree, reading glasses on a chain) carefully checks a small neat stack of invoices with a gold pen, each with a gold star sticker. CENTRE: she leans over a junior accountant (young man, glasses, half-sleeve shirt, eager) who is quickly checking a much bigger pile of invoices with a silver pen; most get silver stickers, but one gets a crooked sticker with a small red smudge, his mistake. RIGHT: a printed one-page checklist rolls off a printer and is being pinned to the walls of three small branch offices drawn in miniature, with clerks at each branch running fast through invoices using it. Dotted arrows carry the gold stack and the silver stack into the checklist, and the red smudge travels along too, appearing faintly on the checklist. Afternoon light through office blinds, files and ledgers on shelves. Labels: "GOLD" over the senior's stack, "SILVER" over the junior's pile, "BI-ENCODER" on the checklist.

key: Learning a language with no teacher
name: ch10_newspaper_cover_words
alt: A young man alone with a pile of newspapers learns a language by covering words with his finger and guessing them.
scene: A close, eye-level view of a small rented room at night. A young man in his twenties (vest, glasses, unshaven, a towel over his shoulder) sits cross-legged on a mattress surrounded by a towering pile of old newspapers in an unfamiliar script. He presses a small paper strip over one word in a headline, his lips moving as he guesses it; a thought bubble above him shows three candidate shapes with a question mark, and when he lifts the strip a small green tick appears over the correct guess. Around him lie a dozen newspapers with words already circled. There is no teacher, no textbook and no answer key, just a steel tumbler of water, a dim lamp and a calendar on the wall with many days crossed out, and a ceiling fan stirring the corners of the pages. In a small inset bubble at the top right, his boss in a suit holds up a stack of specific invoices in the same language, and he looks unsure, since newspapers never covered that. Warm lamplight, quiet determination. Labels: "UNSUPERVISED" above the newspaper pile, "MASKED" on the paper strip.

key: A doctor from Chennai posted to a
name: ch10_doctor_new_posting
alt: A doctor newly posted to a rural Punjab clinic listens to patients for weeks to learn local words for symptoms.
scene: An eye-level view inside a small rural health centre in a Punjab village: whitewashed walls, a ceiling fan, a steel cupboard of medicines, and through the open door, mustard fields in bloom and a tractor. A young woman doctor from the south (late twenties, white coat over a cotton saree, stethoscope, a small notebook in hand) sits at a wooden desk listening carefully. An elderly Punjabi farmer in a turban and kurta sits opposite her, pointing at his stomach and describing it; his speech bubble shows a short squiggly line of local words with a small cartoon of a churning stomach. The doctor is writing the local word next to a medical term in her notebook, with an arrow joining them, building a little glossary. On the wall behind her, her framed medical degree hangs, glowing slightly, showing her training still applies. A queue of village patients waits on a bench outside. A small inset shows an unknown green germ with a question mark, hinting at diseases listening alone cannot diagnose. Bright midday sun, dust motes, warm and patient mood. Labels: "TARGET DOMAIN" on the glossary notebook, "PRETRAINED" on the framed degree.

key: A new hire who already graduated
name: ch11_new_hire_onboarding
alt: A new graduate hire goes through onboarding: practising on real tickets, reading the company wiki, and highlighting names line by line.
scene: A wide, eye-level view of a modern Indian office floor drawn as a left-to-right journey of the same new hire: a young woman of about twenty-three (graduation photo pinned on her desk, lanyard, neat kurta with jeans, eager face). LEFT: on her first day, a manager asks her a question and she answers hesitantly with a question mark above her. CENTRE-LEFT: she sits with a mentor at a desk, practising on a stack of real support tickets, stamping each one with a verdict stamp, a small pile marked with ticks growing. CENTRE-RIGHT: she reads a fat ring binder of the company's internal wiki with coffee, absorbing vocabulary, tiny icons of jargon words floating into her head. RIGHT: she runs a highlighter across a printed document line by line, colouring names, places and company names in different colours, instead of stamping the whole page. A faint dotted arrow connects the four stages. A small inset in the corner shows her graduation cap with a few pages falling out of it, hinting that pushing too hard on narrow training can damage general knowledge. Bright daylight through glass windows, potted plants, a hopeful mood. Labels: "FINE-TUNING" above the tickets, "PRETRAINING" on the wiki binder, "NER" above the highlighter.

key: Setting up the Trainer is like booking
name: ch11_trainer_railway_journey
alt: A railway journey as model training: a ticket, a porter packing equal trolleys, a ticket examiner checking at stations and a departing train.
scene: A wide view of a busy Indian railway platform arranged left to right as a sequence. LEFT: a passenger (young man, backpack, glasses) holds up a printed ticket showing a short list of boxes, "class", "train no." and "date", with a small inset of the ticket magnified. CENTRE-LEFT: a porter in a red shirt with a brass armband loads suitcases of all shapes into a row of identical metal trolleys, padding smaller loads with cloth bundles so every trolley carries the same size stack. CENTRE-RIGHT: a travelling ticket examiner in a black coat with a clipboard stands at the door of a coach checking a progress chart, with small station name boards visible along the track behind him. RIGHT: the long blue train pulls out with a whistle and puffs of steam, passengers waving from windows. A small inset bubble at the top right shows the same passenger at a ticket counter exchanging his ticket for a new one with different boxes ticked, ready to run the trip again. Morning light through the platform roof, bustle of chai vendors and announcements. Labels: "ARGUMENTS" on the ticket, "COLLATOR" above the porter, "METRICS" above the examiner.

key: ledger system: the bottom layers are
name: ch11_ledger_new_branch
alt: A shop owner copies the basic bookkeeping pages of a ledger to a new branch and rewrites only the top pages about customer habits.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, showing the old shop on the left and a newly opened branch on the right. LEFT panel: inside a big established kirana shop, the owner (sixties, white kurta, black-rimmed glasses) holds open a thick ledger drawn as a stack of coloured layers: the thick bottom layers are plain grey pages with columns, dates and addition sums, while the thin top layer is a bright page listing regular customers' faces with credit marks. RIGHT panel: at the new branch, his son (thirties, polo shirt, phone in pocket) has an identical ledger whose grey bottom layers are copied over with a dotted arrow and a small padlock on them, while he is busy rewriting only the top bright page with the faces of new neighbourhood customers. A small inset in the corner of the right panel shows a variant where every layer is padlocked and the son can only change a tiny yes/no rubber stamp at the very top, looking frustrated. Behind both, shelves of sacks and tins and an open shutter to the street. Warm late-afternoon light. Labels: "FROZEN" on the padlocked lower layers, "TRAINABLE" on the top page.

key: A new cashier at a sweet shop learns
name: ch11_sweet_shop_cashier
alt: A new sweet-shop cashier learns to sort orders from just two examples shown by the owner on her first day.
scene: An eye-level view across the glass counter of a busy Indian sweet shop, trays of laddoos, jalebis, barfis and kaju katli glowing under warm lights. On the right, the owner, a portly man in his fifties (cream kurta, gold watch, cheerful moustache), holds up two order slips to show his new cashier: one with a sketch of a huge stack of sweet boxes tied with a ribbon and a tiny wedding garland, and one with a single small box. On the left, the cashier, a young woman in her early twenties (pink salwar kameez, dupatta pinned, notebook in hand), listens and nods, then confidently sorts a fresh pile of incoming slips into two trays: a big tray for bulk orders and a small tray for walk-ins. A thought bubble above her shows her already understanding words and context, with small icons of a wedding, a festival and a family. Behind the counter, a dusty archive cabinet labelled with a very large number of old orders sits untouched with cobwebs. A small inset bubble shows one blurry, smudged example slip and the cashier guessing wrongly. Warm festive evening light. Labels: "FEW-SHOT" above the two example slips.

key: Training a new cook at a dhaba
name: ch12_dhaba_cook_three_stages
alt: A new dhaba cook in three stages: reading about food, learning plates from order slips, and adjusting to regulars' taste preferences.
scene: A three-panel horizontal strip, left to right, the same young cook in every panel: a lanky man in his early twenties with a thin moustache, a vest and a checked towel on his shoulder. PANEL ONE: he sits on a charpai surrounded by cookbooks, food magazines and plates of food from other dhabas, eating and reading, with many small dish pictures floating into his head over a long calendar of years. PANEL TWO: in the dhaba kitchen, the owner (burly man, turban, thick beard) hands him an order slip reading "1 masala dosa" and points to a correct sample plate next to it; the cook copies the plate exactly. PANEL THREE: two regular customers, truck drivers on a bench, taste two versions of the same curry side by side, one glistening with oil and one lighter with extra chutney, and both point at the lighter plate with a thumbs-up while the cook watches and nods. Dotted arrows connect the panels. Highway dhaba setting with a tandoor, a steel water drum and trucks parked outside. Warm afternoon light shifting to evening. Labels: "PRETRAINING" over panel one, "SFT" over panel two, "PREFERENCE" over panel three.

key: The autocomplete on your phone keyboard
name: ch12_keyboard_autocomplete
alt: A person types a question on a phone and the keyboard suggests more words of the question instead of the answer.
scene: A close-up, over-the-shoulder view of a young man in his twenties sitting on a crowded bus, holding a smartphone in both hands, thumbs over the keyboard. On the screen, the typed line reads "What is 1 + 1" and the three suggestion chips above the keyboard read "and", "the" and "in", not an answer. His face, partly visible in the window reflection, shows a puzzled half-smile. A dotted arrow from the suggestion chips loops back into the end of the sentence, showing it only continues the text. Floating above the phone is a thought bubble with a gigantic version of the same keyboard drawn like a towering library of books, suggesting a vastly larger autocomplete that has read a lot. A small inset bubble in the upper corner shows a note with two example question-and-answer pairs written above the question, and the giant keyboard now suggesting "2", hinting that clever prompting can coax answers. Through the bus window, blurred shops and an auto-rickshaw pass by, morning commute light. Labels: "BASE MODEL" above the giant keyboard, "NEXT WORD" on the suggestion chips.

key: Pretraining is reading every newspaper
name: ch12_waiting_room_vs_coaching
alt: A man reads stacks of newspapers in a railway waiting room for years, then attends a coaching class with a question bank and answer key.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, the same man in both halves (thirties, spectacles, sweater vest, cloth bag). LEFT panel: an old railway waiting room with high ceilings, wooden benches and a big station clock; he sits surrounded by towering stacks of newspapers in many languages, reading one after another, and a wall calendar beside him shows many years of pages torn away. RIGHT panel: a small coaching-class room with a whiteboard and fold-out desks; he sits at the front with a slim spiral-bound question bank, and on each page a question is paired with an underlined answer. A strict but friendly tutor in a striped shirt stands at the board writing "Q", an arrow, and "A". A small inset bubble in the corner of the right panel shows a few of the old newspapers from the left panel quietly fading and blowing away, hinting that narrow drilling can overwrite earlier knowledge. Dusty yellow light in the waiting room, bright tube light in the classroom. Labels: "PRETRAINING" over the left panel, "FINE-TUNING" over the right panel.

key: You want your flat to suit a new tenant
name: ch12_flat_rebuild_vs_refurnish
alt: One flat is being demolished and rebuilt, while an identical flat only gets new curtains, lights and furniture.
scene: A split-panel illustration of two identical apartments in a city housing society, seen as cutaway rooms, divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a construction crew in hard hats knocks down walls with sledgehammers, a cement mixer turns, dust fills the air, and a large bill pinned to the door shows a long receipt; the new tenant, a young woman with a suitcase, waits outside looking at her watch. RIGHT panel: the walls stay untouched, freshly painted; a cheerful handyman on a stepladder hangs bright new curtains, a pendant lamp is being swapped, and two helpers carry in a sofa and a rug; the same tenant is already sitting on the new sofa with a cup of tea. A small cardboard box of the old curtains sits by the door, showing the change can be undone. A small inset bubble at the corner of the right panel shows the tenant frowning at a tiny kitchen and wishing it were a big modern one, which curtains cannot fix. Bright afternoon light, the left side chaotic and expensive, the right calm and cheap. Labels: "FULL FINE-TUNING" over the left panel, "PEFT" over the right panel.

key: Like a recipe card at a cooking class
name: ch12_recipe_card_steps
