alt: At a cooking class, students follow a recipe card: prepare ingredients, shrink the pot, choose spices, set the flame, cook and plate.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated view of a cheerful cooking class in a community hall, with a long counter running left to right and six stations along it. A large laminated recipe card on an easel at the left shows six numbered steps with tiny icons. At station one, a student chops vegetables into neat bowls; at station two, a big pot is swapped for a small one that fits a single-burner stove; at station three, a student picks just a few jars from a large spice rack, the others marked with a small lock; at station four, a hand turns a flame knob while a kitchen timer is set; at station five, a pot bubbles with steam; at station six, a student plates the finished dish with a garnish. The instructor, a lively woman in her forties in an apron and bandana, walks along the counter giving a thumbs-up. Dotted arrows link the stations in order. Big windows let in warm morning light, and a few students in the background taste and compare notes with a little shrug, hinting the timings needed experiments. Labels: "QUANTIZE" above the small pot, "LORA" above the spice rack, "MERGE" above the plated dish.

key: Shipping a sofa in a flat-pack box
name: ch12_flat_pack_sofa
alt: A sofa travels as a compact flat-pack box in a van and is assembled piece by piece only when someone wants to sit.
scene: A two-part scene across a single wide frame. LEFT: the open back of a small delivery van shows four slim flat cardboard boxes stacked neatly, taking up only a quarter of the cargo space, while a large fully assembled sofa beside the van is drawn faintly with a dotted outline, too big to fit, filling the whole van. A delivery man in a cap and overalls gives a thumbs-up. RIGHT: in a living room, a family of three, a father in a kurta, a mother in a salwar kameez and a small girl, unpack one box and screw together just one seat cushion and one armrest with a small hex key, right when the father wants to sit and watch the cricket on TV; the other boxes stay flat against the wall. A dotted arrow runs from the flat box to the assembled piece and back. A tiny inset bubble shows the assembled armrest slightly lopsided compared to a showroom photo, hinting the rebuilt piece is not exactly the original. Warm evening light from a floor lamp, cosy and practical. Labels: "4-BIT STORAGE" on the van boxes, "COMPUTE" above the family assembling the piece.

key: is how many knobs you give the sound
name: ch12_sound_engineer_knobs
alt: A sound engineer at a mixing desk with only a few knobs on chosen instruments and one master volume slider.
scene: An eye-level view inside a small recording studio during a live music session. Behind a glass window on the right, a band plays: a tabla player, a flautist, a guitarist and a singer in a kurta at a microphone. In the foreground on the left, a sound engineer in her thirties (headphones over a short haircut, black T-shirt, focused expression) sits at a mixing desk. Unusually, the desk has only a small row of eight knobs, and thin cables run from them to just two of the instruments, the singer's microphone and the flute, while the tabla and guitar have no cable at all, with a small grey dash next to them. A single large master slider sits at the right end of the desk, and her hand is pushing it up; a curved arrow shows how far it can travel. Glowing VU meters dance on the desk. A small inset bubble shows two of the knobs tied together by a thin string, turning together, hinting they are not independent. Warm amber studio lights and blue LED glow. Labels: "RANK" on the row of knobs, "ALPHA" on the master slider, "TARGET MODULES" on the two cables.

key: Driving a new car out of the showroom
name: ch12_drive_warmup_cooldown
alt: A new car eases out of a showroom, speeds along a highway, then slows smoothly to park precisely at home.
scene: A wide, panoramic side view of a single road journey drawn left to right, with the same small new hatchback car shown at three points, still wearing a red ribbon on its bonnet. LEFT: it rolls slowly out of a glass showroom door, a salesman in a tie waving, the driver (a young man in a checked shirt, both hands carefully on the wheel) easing forward, only short speed lines behind the car. CENTRE: the car cruises fast on an open highway with long speed lines, green fields, a toll plaza in the distance and a confident driver. RIGHT: the car slows smoothly as it turns into a quiet residential lane and parks precisely between two flower pots in front of a house with a blue gate, a family waving from the doorway. Above the road, a thin curve traces the speed: rising gently, holding high, then gliding down in a smooth arc to zero at the gate. A small inset bubble shows the driver blindfolded, steering only by a needle on a gauge, hinting the optimizer sees only the loss. Late-afternoon golden light, satisfied mood. Labels: "WARMUP" under the showroom, "COSINE DECAY" under the lane.

key: Judging a new hire: a typing test
name: ch12_five_ways_judge_hire
alt: A new hire is judged five ways: a typing test, an aptitude exam, a class rank board, a code review and a month with the team.
scene: A wide view of an office drawn as five small scenes in a row from left to right, the same new hire in each (young man in his early twenties, neat haircut, light-blue shirt, ID card). ONE: he types at a keyboard while a stopwatch ticks beside him. TWO: he sits in an exam hall bubbling answers on a printed aptitude sheet. THREE: he stands beside a noticeboard ranking many names, his name highlighted at a middle rank. FOUR: a senior engineer in her forties with reading glasses reviews his code on a large monitor, pointing at a line with a pen. FIVE: he sits around a table with his team over chai and laptops, sharing a laugh during a month-long project, with a small calendar showing four weeks. Above all five scenes floats a big jigsaw outline of a person with five pieces, each piece coming from one scene, and one piece still missing. A small inset bubble shows the same hire answering the same question twice with two different expressions, hinting that models are less consistent than people. Bright office daylight, positive but thoughtful mood. Labels: "BENCHMARK" above scene two, "LLM JUDGE" above scene four, "HUMAN EVAL" above scene five.

key: Perplexity is like how surprised
name: ch12_commuter_perplexity
alt: A seasoned local-train commuter is calm at each station announcement, while a first-time visitor is startled by every one.
scene: An eye-level view inside a crowded suburban local train compartment in a big Indian city, with metal grab handles, ceiling fans and open doors through which a platform rushes past. On the left, a seasoned commuter in his fifties (white shirt, office bag, folded newspaper, relaxed half-closed eyes) mouths the next station name a moment before the speaker announces it, and a small calm green dial above his head points to low. On the right, a first-time visitor (young tourist with a big backpack and a map) jumps in surprise at the announcement, his own red dial swinging to high. The ceiling speaker emits a sound wave bubble containing a small station-board icon. In the background, people hang from the door frame and a vendor sells peanuts. A small inset bubble in the upper corner shows the same calm commuter sitting in a dirty, late, overcrowded train, still perfectly unsurprised, hinting that low surprise says nothing about quality. Bright morning light streaming through barred windows. Labels: "LOW PERPLEXITY" above the commuter, "HIGH PERPLEXITY" above the visitor.

key: A singing reality show: two contestants
name: ch12_singing_show_judge
alt: On a singing show two contestants sing the same song and a judge simply points to the better one.
scene: A wide, front-on view of a glittering television singing-contest stage with coloured spotlights and a live audience in the background. On the left, a young woman contestant in a sequinned kurta sings into a microphone with eyes closed; on the right, a young man contestant in a jacket sings the same song, both with the same music sheet icon above them. In the foreground, at a curved judges' desk, a single judge in her forties (elegant silk saree, statement earrings, expressive face) raises one arm and points decisively at the woman, while a big score card with "7.3" lies face down and ignored on the desk. A large electronic panel behind the stage shows two simple boxes with a tick in one. A small inset bubble at the top corner shows the same judge leaning toward a contestant who is louder, with a giant speaker beside him, hinting at bias toward volume or order. Bright stage lighting, sparkles and confetti, an energetic mood. Labels: "A VS B" on the electronic panel, "PREFERRED" above the woman.

key: if a call centre measures agents only
name: ch12_call_centre_goodhart
alt: Call centre agents hang up quickly to improve the average call-time chart while unsolved customer problems pile up.
scene: A wide view of a call-centre floor with rows of cubicles, headsets and blue monitor glow. On the back wall, a large digital display shows a bar chart of average call time falling steeply, with a manager in a blazer standing under it, smiling and giving a thumbs-up. In the cubicles below, agents in headsets are slamming down calls mid-sentence, one young man pressing the end button with a sly grin, a stopwatch on his desk reading "0:45". Outside a window on the right, connected by dotted lines from the cubicles, a crowd of frustrated customers grows: an old man with a broken phone, a woman holding a wrong bill, a student with a laptop showing an error, each with a small storm cloud above their heads, and a pile of unanswered complaint letters growing taller beside them. The contrast is clear: the chart goes down while the pile goes up. A small inset bubble at the corner shows a machine with gears automatically finding the quickest hang-up button without any grin at all. Cool fluorescent light inside, grey overcast light outside. Labels: "METRIC" on the bar chart, "REAL GOAL" above the angry customers.

key: A chai stall owner trying new recipes
name: ch12_chai_stall_ratings
alt: A chai stall owner tries new recipes and customers rate each cup; high-rated recipes are made more and low ones dropped.
scene: An eye-level view of a lively roadside chai stall in the evening, a big aluminium kettle steaming on a kerosene stove, glass jars of rusks and biscuits on the counter. The owner, a wiry man in his forties (vest, checked lungi, sweat towel, curious grin), pours three different recipes into small glasses: one with ginger, one with cardamom and one with too much sugar. A small chalkboard on the stall pole lists the three recipes with tally marks. Customers around the stall, a college student, an auto driver and an office worker, sip and hold up small hand-cards with stars: the ginger chai gets many stars, the sugary one gets a frown and a single star. Dotted arrows show the owner moving the ginger recipe jar to the front of the counter and pushing the sugary jar toward a dustbin. In the background, a long queue of many more customers stretches down the street into the dusk, far too many to ask one by one. Warm light from a hanging bulb against a purple evening sky. Labels: "REWARD" above the star cards.

key: A retired cricketer becomes a
name: ch12_cricketer_turned_commentator
alt: A retired cricketer who once batted on the field now sits in the commentary box holding up a single score card for another player's shot.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, the same man in both halves. LEFT panel: in his playing days, a fit cricketer in his late twenties in whites and a helmet plays a powerful cover drive on a sunlit pitch, the ball racing to the boundary and the crowd cheering. RIGHT panel: years later, the same man now in his fifties (greying hair, blazer with a badge, headset) sits in a glass commentary box overlooking the ground; below, a young batsman plays a shot, and instead of swinging a bat himself, the commentator holds up a single card with the number "8" on it. A faint glowing outline of his old bat leans in the corner of the box, and a dotted line connects his head in both panels to show the same cricket knowledge. A small inset bubble near his card shows a pile of paired viewer votes, two shots with a tick beside one, hinting where his judgement comes from. Bright sunshine on the left, cool glass reflections and floodlights on the right. Labels: "GENERATE" over the left panel, "SCORE" over the right panel, "REWARD MODEL" above the commentator.

key: A student (LLM) practises essays; a
name: ch12_tutor_marks_essays
alt: A student writes essays and two tutors give marks, one for content and one for safety, while a rule warns against big style changes.
scene: An eye-level view of a home tuition room with a study table, a ceiling fan and a bookshelf. In the centre, a student in her teens (school uniform, ponytail, ink on her fingers) writes an essay in a notebook. On the right sit two tutors side by side: a lively young man with a red pen who marks content with a number on top of each essay, and a calm older woman in a shawl with a green stamp checking that nothing offensive was written. A stack of earlier essays beside the student shows marks growing from left to right, each essay only slightly different in handwriting from the previous one. On the wall, a framed school rule poster with a short line and an icon of a small step instead of a big jump warns against changing style too drastically at once. Above the tutors, a thought bubble shows a pile of examiner reports they learned from. A small inset bubble shows the student asking "why?" while the tutor only holds up a number. Warm afternoon light, focused and encouraging mood. Labels: "POLICY" above the student, "REWARD MODELS" above the two tutors, "PROXIMAL" on the rule poster.

key: first a driving school teaches you
name: ch12_driving_school_vs_combined
alt: One learner takes a driving school course then a separate defensive-driving course; another takes a single combined course.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: two driving-school buildings stand along the same road with a dotted path between them. A learner (young woman, ponytail, sunglasses) first sits in a small dual-control training car with an instructor at a driving school, then later walks to a second building where a different instructor shows a whiteboard with safe and unsafe habits, such as a car keeping distance and a car tailgating. RIGHT panel: a single larger driving school where the same learner drives the training car around a practice track while one instructor beside her teaches steering and also flags unsafe habits on the spot, holding a small red flag out of the window as she cuts too close to a cone. Traffic cones, a zebra crossing and a dummy traffic signal fill both practice grounds. A small inset bubble on the right panel shows a tangled ball of wires over the instructor's head, hinting the combined course is harder to tune. Bright sunny morning, clear blue sky. Labels: "SFT THEN DPO" over the left panel, "ORPO" over the right panel.

key: did not invent money or bank accounts
name: ch13_payment_layer_on_banks
alt: A fast digital payment layer of glowing tracks runs on top of old bank buildings, carrying payments between small shops.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated view of an Indian town square cut away like a layered cake. On the bottom layer, a row of solid old bank buildings with stone pillars, vaults and ledgers stands untouched, clerks working inside. Built right on top of their roofs runs a shiny new layer of glowing rails, like a light metro track, connecting every corner of the square. Along this top layer, small glowing payment tokens zip between a fruit cart, a tea stall, a tailor shop and an auto-rickshaw, each with a small QR stand, while customers hold up phones and smile as a tiny tick appears. Cables drop down from the rails into each bank, showing the layer still depends on the banks below. A young engineer in a hard hat and a laptop bag inspects a section of the rails, adding a small checkpoint gate with a gauge and a shield, and a few tokens wobbling on a curved stretch are caught by it. Bright late-morning sunlight, a sense of hustle and modern energy. Labels: "LLM" on the bank buildings, "YOUR LAYER" on the glowing rails, "GUARDRAILS" on the checkpoint gate.

key: which train, which class and which
name: ch13_rush_booking_prep
alt: A traveller sits calmly before a rush-hour train booking opens with a short card listing train, class and payment, while the rulebook stays shut.
scene: A close, eye-level view of a young man in his twenties (T-shirt, headphones around his neck, focused calm face) sitting at a desk at home a minute before a busy railway booking window opens. A wall clock behind him shows a minute to the hour, its second hand almost at twelve. On his laptop screen a generic booking page is loaded with a big ticking countdown. Beside the laptop he has a small index card propped against a mug with three short lines: a train number, "3A" and "UPI", each with a tick. A giant, dusty railway rulebook sits on a far shelf, closed, a little cobweb on it. On the right side of the frame, his flatmate in a vest and shorts is frantically flipping through a thick book of rules, papers flying, sweating and panicking as the countdown nears zero, a half-eaten slice of toast forgotten on his plate. A small inset bubble shows the same young man in an interview room, now with only three book chapters in his hand, answering in depth. Cool early-morning light from a window. Labels: "PLAN" on the index card, "RULEBOOK" on the closed book.
